Subject: FinWork — post-call TCO recap & next steps

Hi Sam / Olivia,

Thanks again for the 30-minute call today — really useful to hear about the FinWork production timeline and constraints. Below is a short recap plus the immediate next steps I promised.

TL;DR: primary driver is predictable per-request cost within a $12k/mo budget for our pilot (50k requests/month), and reducing latency spikes during end-of-month reports. Key levers: batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantized dedicated instances for high-throughput endpoints.

Pain points you shared:
- Token costs are the biggest unknown — current vendor billing is spiky and hard to forecast for month-end processing.
- Latency spikes during bulk reports affect user experience and SLA commitments to your customers.
- Procurement wants a simple ROI: investment vs monthly unit-cost delta and payback within q4.

What we recommend (high level):
1) Batching + adaptive scheduling — aggregate similar short requests into micro-batches to reduce per-token overhead (expect ~20–35% token-cost reduction depending on shape).
2) Prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts — storing common prompts/KV for conversational flows reduces redundant computation (up to 40% savings on repeated queries).
3) Quantized dedicated capacity for the heavy nightly workloads — cheaper per-token with predictable throughput and autoscaling for spikes.
4) Monitoring + cost alerts — token-level dashboards and per-route cost caps to avoid runaway bills.

Attached: Redwood_TCO_Model_FinWork.xlsx (interactive TCO model — inputs highlighted in yellow). I populated the pilot assumptions you gave (50k requests/mo, avg 120 tokens/request, 2x repeat rate during reports) — see tab "Pilot_Summary".

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm the pilot budget cap ($12k/mo) and the preferred start window (you mentioned late Sep?).
- We: share a short ROI slide and a 30-min follow-up to walk the model with procurement + tech (I can present).
- If you want, we can also scope a short pilot contract (30–60 days) with an opt-out and SLA guardrails.

Available times this week for the follow-up: Thu 9/3 10am-12pm PT or Fri 9/4 1-3pm PT. I can shift if needed.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
